title: Associated Bank accelerates commercial growth with new Franchise Banking vertical
summary: Associated Banc-Corp (NYSE: ASB) (Associated) launched a new, nationally focused Franchise Banking vertical, expanding its portfolio of industry-specific specialty financial solutions and deepening its commitment to serving franchise owners and operators across the country.
